text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Today's finally my debut race. This is 
where it all begins...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I wonder if I can really run 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What if I totally screw up... What're we 
gonna do then~~?!
(So light and airy...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya? Such a savory, lovely aroma...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Yukino-san. Would you like... some 
coffee?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Manhattan Cafe-san. My roommate, who 
possesses a mysterious charm.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are ya sure? Thank ya kindly, gansu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... I wonder if I can finish it all 
while it's this bitter...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. I made this especially for 
Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, it's sweet! It tastes like 
vanilla!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Here is your vanilla latte. I added milk 
to make it even mellower.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I see... It warms me right up...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, to tell you the truth, I was super 
anxious up until just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've calmed down a bit! This 
"caffeine" stuff is downright incredible, 
ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't no use fretting over it now. All I 
can do is brace myself and go for it!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...Take care, Yukino-san."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank ye kindly!

Today is Yukino Bijin's debut race. After 
seeing her off to the waiting room, I went 
to check on the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, so this is a racetrack. It's my 
first time here, and it's pretty huuuuge.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait to see Yukino-chan in 
person♪ Hey, I wanna watch while sipping 
coffee! Let's be a little adventurous!"

It seems a lot of the spectators here 
today came specifically to see Yukino 
Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin... why is she so popular? 
There's no way she's actually that good.

Of course, there are some who doubt Yukino 
Bijin's popularity... but that skepticism 
only exists because she draws so much 
attention.
choice_data_list:
(It really has become a huge craze, hasn't 
it?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—W-w-what?!? There are so many of my fans 
here...?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... R-Really?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could I get, like, a whole 
liter of coffee!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My chest is all thumping and flustered, ya 
know! I gotta borrow the power of that 
caffeine!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't live up to everyone's 
expectations, I...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Remember who else is putting their hopes 
on you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Mom, Dad, everyone back 
home, Mifuyu-chan... they all cheered me 
on and sent me off...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Besides! We decided to steel our resolve, 
didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes...! I'm all right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yukino, a boom is a chance—seize it!
Yukino, a boom is a chance, you know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's right! A craze is an opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's gonna have a super-duper 
debut!
